status: DRAFT, not registered. Nothing here is frozen, reviewed or authorised.
names: Lab ids are lab_fixed_N and lab_adaptive_N, and lab_e0, lab_e1, lab_e2. PROTOCOL already uses C0 and M1 for A19's arms, and the correction note uses E1 and E2 for clean and wrong-history shapes; the brief's names would collide on the ledger.

noise_pair.what: Two seeds of the balanced fixed curriculum, four 512-step legs each, read on T_M and T_E. Excluded from every later comparison, so selecting on it biases nothing. It gives pair_sd_points, and the stage gate.
noise_pair.stage_gate: The comparison is registered only if, after this pair, some family stays above 0.15 nats excess beyond its noise. Otherwise the fixed curriculum stands.
noise_pair.pair_sd_rule: pair_sd_points = max(measured, 6.9). One pair measures its own spread with one degree of freedom, and 6.9 points is the one-seed null on record, a20_bars.json, on another scale.

adaptive_pilot.registered: after the noise pair, with numbers in the rule, before any comparison model exists
adaptive_pilot.dev_reads: the start checkpoint, then steps 512, 1024 and 1536, in every arm
adaptive_pilot.family_shares: of sampled decision tokens, with equal decision and supervised totals in both arms
adaptive_pilot.development_instrument: T_M, family loss in nats per target, frozen before the signal read. If the signal read fails, the pilot stops; a change of metric is a new registration.
adaptive_pilot.signal_read: as PLAN.md states it, read once on pk_sft_v1, S54 and S55 before any L4
adaptive_pilot.primary: request-turn task points on T_E, by template group, fixed against adaptive, paired bootstrap of 10,000 draws, with between-seed variance added
guards: worst-family excess on T_E no more than 0.15 nats beyond fixed
adaptive_pilot.practical_points: max(7.0, 2 x pair_sd_points / sqrt(3)), computed before the comparison is registered

arms.lab_e0: ordinary continuation on the parent's packet
arms.lab_e2: verified rows from T_C, cells weighted by T_M failure, within 0.25 to 3 times the verified share

error_pilot.seeds: one seed is a screen, and can reach SCREEN_PROMISING at most. A claim needs three.
error_pilot.replay: the same allocation in all three arms
error_pilot.primary: lab_e2 against lab_e1, told recall on T_E, by frame
error_pilot.history: clean histories only. Recovery from the model's own wrong turns is a separate later experiment, and the earlier self-copy cascade was history-specific
error_pilot.continuation_rule: none here: another round needs its own registered criteria

pk_sft_v1.floors: S54, S55, and one mixed-row specialist to train
